einzeiler: Tech employment drops while AI drives up PC prices and reshapes leadership at Adobe.
kurzfassung: The information sector shed 23,000 jobs in August, contrasting with a strong overall US jobs report. Meanwhile, Adobe shares dropped over five percent following the appointment of Anil Chakravarti as its new CEO. Additionally, memory chip shortages driven by AI have led to rising PC prices and falling shipments.
stichpunkte: Information industry employment decreased by 23,000 jobs in August.
Computing infrastructure and web hosting services lost 8,000 jobs during the same month.
Adobe's stock fell over five percent following the announcement of a new CEO.
Anil Chakravarti will take over as Adobe CEO in December after leading its customer experience division.
Chakravarti previously oversaw the development of generative AI platforms like GenStudio.
AI-driven memory chip shortages caused global PC shipments to drop nearly five percent in Q2.
International Data Core projects PC prices to increase by 20 percent this year.
Despite lower unit sales, brands like HP, Dell, and Lenovo saw boosted overall revenues from pricier computers.
beschreibung:
Plus: Adobe stock falls after it names a new CEO. And computer makers are seeing gains from selling fewer PCs at higher prices. Julie Chang hosts.
